name: wod6e
description: ESLint & other utiltiies for developing World of Darkness 6th Edition

scripts.convert-clans: fvtt package unpack -n Clans --clean --inputDirectory ./packs/ --outputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_clans && fvtt package pack -n Clans --inputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_clans --outputDirectory ./packs --nedb
scripts.convert-actions: fvtt package unpack -n Actions --clean --inputDirectory ./packs/ --outputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_actions && fvtt package pack -n Actions --inputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_actions --outputDirectory ./packs --nedb
scripts.convert-conditions: fvtt package unpack -n Conditions --clean --inputDirectory ./packs/ --outputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_conditions && fvtt package pack -n Conditions --inputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_conditions --outputDirectory ./packs --nedb
scripts.convert-paths: fvtt package unpack -n Paths --clean --inputDirectory ./packs/ --outputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_paths && fvtt package pack -n Paths --inputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_paths --outputDirectory ./packs --nedb
scripts.convert-packs: npm run convert-clans && npm run convert-actions && npm run convert-conditions && npm run convert-paths
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:less && npm run lint:hbs && npm run format:check

author: Veilza
